import json,os,sys,aiohttp
print(json.dumps({'uid':os.getuid(),'gid':os.getgid(),'python':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'aiohttp':aiohttp.__version__,'source':aiohttp.__file__,'virtual_env':os.environ.get('VIRTUAL_ENV')},sort_keys=True))
print('RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE='+sys.executable)
try:
    fd = os.open('/rh2/bash_env', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND)
except PermissionError:
    print('RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=DENIED')
except OSError as exc:
    print('RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=ERROR', repr(exc))
else:
    os.close(fd)
    print('RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=WRITABLE')

purpose: 运行最终题面的解析器示例并核对公开约定异常
cmd:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python - <<'RH2_AIO_PUBLIC'
import asyncio
from unittest import mock
from aiohttp import http_parser, http_exceptions

def test_invalid_header(parser):
    invalid_header = "\xffoo: bar"
    request = f"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\n{invalid_header}\r\n\r\n".encode()
    parser.feed_data(request)

def test_malformed_status_line(parser):
    malformed_status = b"GET\n/path\x0cHTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"
    parser.feed_data(malformed_status)

loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
try:
    parser = http_parser.HttpRequestParserPy(mock.Mock(), loop, 2**16)
    try:
        test_invalid_header(parser)
    except http_exceptions.BadHttpMessage as exc:
        print(type(exc).__name__, ascii(str(exc)))
    else:
        raise AssertionError('the example returned without BadHttpMessage')
finally:
    loop.close()
RH2_AIO_PUBLIC
